headline: Wednesday on the Lake: Mild skies, holiday lights, and steady fishing
lede: Wednesday, November 18 — a classic midweek Branson day with highs near 66°F, mostly cloudy skies, no rain, and calm winds. Table Rock Lake remains fishable with stable levels; holiday shows are in full swing and the Landing fountain dances on schedule.

featured.title: A Branson Christmas
featured.why: Joyful holiday production with live music, dancing, and festive storytelling — perfect for first-timers starting the season right

plan.title: Lake Sunrise
plan.detail: Enjoy a peaceful early drive or short walk near Table Rock Lake. Mild temps and clear conditions make for excellent visibility across the water.

plan.title: Landing Exploration
plan.detail: Stroll The Landing for shops, the dancing fountain, and lake views. Grab coffee and watch boats while soaking in the early holiday decorations.

plan.title: Evening Show
plan.detail: Catch a marquee holiday performance. Many theatres light up early — book ahead for the best seats and full festive experience.
